issue.title: Skip explain phase when only suggestions are requested

labels.name: :Search Relevance/Suggesters
labels.description: "Did you mean" and suggestions as you type

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
In case a search request holds only the suggest section, the query phase
is skipped and only the suggest phase is executed instead. There will
never be hits returned, and in case the explain flag is set to true, the
 explain sub phase throws a null pointer exception as the query is null.
This happens only when using the completion suggester as it uses the 
fetch phase to fetch the documents to be returned as part of the suggest
section included in the response.
Usually a null query is replaced with a match all query as part of 
`SearchContext#preProcess` which is though skipped as well with suggest
 only searches. To address this, we skip the explain sub fetch phase
 for search requests that only requested suggestions.

Closes #31260
